info.title: ODataBridge.Cli
info.description: CLI tool for bridging legacy OData V3 services into modern .NET workflows.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI for generating modern .NET clients from legacy OData V1-V3 metadata.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate a V3 client from metadata or a legacy connected service configuration.

options.name: --config-file
options.description: Path to a legacy OData Connected Service JSON file.

options.name: --metadata
options.description: Path or URL to an OData metadata document. Overrides the endpoint from --config-file.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Directory where generated files should be written.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Override the generated client namespace. When omitted, the metadata namespace is used.

options.name: --file-name-prefix
options.description: Override the generated output file name prefix. Defaults to Reference.

options.name: --use-data-service-collection
options.description: Override whether generated types use DataServiceCollection support. Accepts true or false.

options.name: --split-files
options.description: Write one generated C# file per top-level type. Accepts true or false.

options.name: --file-scoped-namespaces
options.description: Rewrite generated namespaces to file-scoped form. Defaults to true when files are split.
